module: Selection geometry of the Easy Select tool: box validation, computation of an object's 8 world corners (oriented box via getObjBox + transform + scale, world-aligned box for vehicles or as a fallback), camera context, bounds signatures to detect that an object has moved, and creation of screen-projected "proxies" (convex hull polygon, area, centroid, distances, volume). These proxies are used to choose the object under the mouse.
notes: Bounds types: "vehicleWorldAabb" (BeamNGVehicle), "oriented", "worldAabb". Proxy creation failure reasons: invalidBounds, degenerateBounds, outsideNearPlane, degenerateProjection.

createCameraContext computes rangeOrigin: impact point of a 5000 m ray in front of the camera; otherwise the terrain height under the camera; otherwise the impact of a downward ray. A proxy's distances (cameraDistance) are measured from this point.
The screen coordinates of the polygons are relative to the viewport (0..width, 0..height), whereas modalOperatorCommon.projectToScreen adds viewportX/Y.

validBox.desc: Tests that a box has finite minExtents/maxExtents (|v| < 1e10, no NaN) and min <= max on each axis.

getBoundsSignature.desc: Returns a list of numbers describing the current bounds of an object (type, transform, scale, box). Used to compare two states with boundsSignaturesEqual. The result table is reused if provided.

returns.desc: signature, or nil if no valid box

boundsSignaturesEqual.desc: Compares two signatures element by element.

returns.desc: false if one is nil or of different length

createCameraContext.desc: Captures the editor camera (core_camera position, quat, FOV) and the main imgui viewport.

returns.desc: {pos, rangeOrigin, right, forward, up, halfTan, aspect, width, height, viewportX, viewportY, nearDistance} or nil if data is missing or the viewport is empty

getWorldCorners.desc: The 8 world corners of an object's box.

getObjectVolume.desc: Box volume (extents x absolute scale for oriented objects).

returns.desc: volume in m3 (world units), nil if invalid or not finite

createProjectedProxy.desc: Builds an object's proxy for the camera: screen polygon of the convex hull of the corners (clipped at the near plane), area, centroid, camera/view distances, volume, oriented box.

returns.desc: {source, sourceId, boundsType, worldCorners, polygon, area, centroid, cameraDistance, viewDistance, volume, cameraInside, orientedBox, boundsSignature}

updateCursorMetrics.desc: Adds to the proxy cursorDistance (distance in pixels from the cursor to the polygon, 0 if inside) and centerBias (distance to the centroid divided by the square root of the area).

updateRayEntry.desc: Adds proxy.rayEntry: entry distance of the ray into the oriented box (math.huge if it misses it or without a ray).

createProxy.desc: Shortcut: createProjectedProxy then updateCursorMetrics then updateRayEntry.
